Package qupath.ext.omero.gui.connectionsmanager

Class ConnectionsManager

java.lang.Object
javafx.stage.Window
javafx.stage.Stage
qupath.ext.omero.gui.connectionsmanager.ConnectionsManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class ConnectionsManager extends javafx.stage.Stage implements AutoCloseable
The connection manager provides a window that displays the connections to all servers. The user can connect, log in, log out, and remove a connection to a server.

Each connection is displayed using the Connection pane.

An instance of this class must be closed once no longer used.
